title: Add detailed pada information to current nakshatra display

requirements.text: Create a comprehensive pada data structure containing all 108 pada descriptions (4 padas for each of the 27 nakshatras) with the following fields: nakshatra name, pada number (1-4), degree range, navamsa sign, title, and full interpretive description text as provided by the user

quotes: add pada details in the main page (current pada)
here is the info for each pada

acceptanceCriteria: Data structure includes all 27 nakshatras with 4 padas each (108 total)
Each pada entry contains nakshatra name, pada number, degree range, navamsa sign, title, and complete description text
All provided pada descriptions from Ashwini through Shravana are accurately captured

requirements.text: Extend the nakshatraEngine utility to calculate not just the current nakshatra but also the specific pada (1-4) based on the Moon's precise degree position within the nakshatra's 13°20' range

quotes: current pada info represent the current lunar climate

acceptanceCriteria: Function calculates current pada by dividing nakshatra degree range into 4 equal parts (3°20' each)
Returns pada number (1-4) along with current nakshatra
Calculation updates in real-time with Moon position changes

requirements.text: Update the CurrentNakshatraBanner component to display the current pada information including pada number, navamsa sign, title, and full interpretive description representing the current lunar climate

quotes: add pada details in the main page (current pada)
make the current pada info represent the current lunar climate

acceptanceCriteria: Component displays current pada number (1-4) alongside nakshatra name
Shows navamsa sign and pada title
Displays full pada description text in a readable format
Updates automatically when Moon transitions to a new pada
Visual presentation is consistent with existing banner design

requirements.text: Add a visual indicator or emphasis showing that the displayed pada information represents the current lunar climate and emotional atmosphere

quotes: make the current pada info represent the current lunar climate

acceptanceCriteria: Clear visual treatment distinguishes current pada as representing present lunar climate
Language or labeling emphasizes real-time lunar influence
Design maintains cosmic/astronomical aesthetic of existing interface

constraints: Do not modify the backend - all pada calculations and data should live in the frontend
Preserve the existing CurrentNakshatraBanner component structure and styling approach
Maintain the 5-minute refresh interval for nakshatra calculations
Do not alter the existing nakshatra grid or detail pages
nonGoals: Adding pada information to individual nakshatra detail pages
Creating admin functionality to edit pada descriptions
Storing pada data in the backend canister
Adding pada filtering or search functionality
Creating separate pages for pada information
